BtErr_t BtMsgInitialize (  ) 

BtMsgInitialize

Initializes the bluetooth messaging system. After this call is made the daemon is ready to receive/send bluetooth messages. BtMsgShutdown must be called to shutdown message system

Return values:
BtErrSuccess upon success, appropriate error code otherwise

BtErr_t BtMsgShutdown (  ) 

BtMsgShutdown

shutsdown the bluetooth messaging system. After this call is made the daemon will no longer send/receive messages. BtMsgInitialize should be called to bring up the message system.

Return values:
BtErrSuccess upon success, appropriate error code otherwise
